title: What's the Purpose of the Uvula?

scenes.label: BACTERIA TRAP
scenes.text: The uvula helps to trap bacteria and other debris that enter the nasal cavity

scenes.label: SALIVA PRODUCTION
scenes.text: It also plays a role in the production of saliva and the swallowing process

scenes.label: INFLAMMATION RISK
scenes.text: In some cases, the uvula can become inflamed or infected, leading to painful symptoms
Follow for a mind-blowing fact every day.

description: The uvula is a small organ located in the back of the throat, but it plays a vital role in our overall health. Find out what its purpose is and how it affects our daily lives. Follow us for more fascinating facts about the human body!
